Authentication.name: Repeated Failed Login Attempts
Authentication.description: High volume of failed authentication attempts within a short timeframe.

Authentication.name: Impossible Travel / Anomaly Location
Authentication.description: Successful user login from geographically impossible locations or anomalous hours.

Authentication.name: MFA Spamming / Push Fatigue
Authentication.description: Multiple sequential Multi-Factor Authentication requests pushed to a user.

Network.name: Abnormal Outbound Data Volume
Network.description: Large volume of encrypted or unknown protocol egress traffic.

Network.name: Internal Network / Port Reconnaissance
Network.description: Sequential connections across internal IP ranges or port numbers.

Network.name: High Volume of Subdomain DNS Queries
Network.description: Anomalous DNS query volume containing base64/encoded domain pre-pendings.

Network.name: Connection to Known C2 / TOR Node
Network.description: Egress traffic directed to flagged Threat Intel IPs or anonymizing networks.

System.name: Sustained Near-100% CPU/GPU Spike
System.description: Unexplained continuous hardware utilization by unknown background tasks.

System.name: Encoded PowerShell / Cmd Execution
System.description: Process execution involving obfuscated CLI arguments or base64 payloads.

System.name: Volume Shadow Copies Purged
System.description: Commands executed to erase backup shadow copies (e.g., vssadmin delete shadows).

Filesystem.name: Rapid Bulk File Renaming / Extensions
Filesystem.description: Files rapidly converted to known ransomware extension formats.

Filesystem.name: Ransom Note Dropped in Directories
Filesystem.description: Text or HTML files containing payment demands created across directories.

Filesystem.name: Mass Access to Confidential Repositories
Filesystem.description: Unusual volume of file read operations on restricted shares or drives.

Email.name: User Clicked Link in External Email
Email.description: Egress telemetry confirms navigation to link received from unverified sender.

Email.name: Display Name Spoofing / Domain Misspelling
Email.description: Email headers show typosquatting or altered reply-to fields impersonating VIPs.

Web Application.name: SQL Injection Strings in Request URIs
Web Application.description: HTTP GET/POST logs containing UNION, SELECT, OR 1=1 or sleep commands.

Web Application.name: Script Tags / Handlers in Web Inputs
Web Application.description: Parameters containing <script>, alert(), or onerror= JS execution syntax.

User Activity.name: Off-Hours Mass File Download/Export
User Activity.description: Employee account downloading customer DBs or repos outside shift hours.

User Activity.name: Local Antivirus / EDR Terminated
User Activity.description: Security agent service stopped or uninstalled manually.

Privilege & Access.name: Unscheduled Administrator Account Creation
Privilege & Access.description: New privileged user added to domain or local Administrators group.

Privilege & Access.name: LSASS Memory Access / Mimikatz Signature
Privilege & Access.description: Process attempting read/dump access on lsass.exe process memory.
